intent: Split the 289-line transcribe_helpers.py into a probes/operations module and a CLI dispatch module, both under the 250-line cap, moving every definition verbatim.
scope: New: _transcribe_probes.py 177 (dependency probes, sine WAV, model prep, CUDA probe)
Re-pointed the module under test in three test files
Non-goal: any behaviour change, including the unreachable dispatch guard
changes: Extracted _try_import, the four dependency probes, generate_sine_wav, prepare_model and test_cuda into _transcribe_probes.py; transcribe_helpers.py keeps the eight _handle_* functions and main().
transcribe_helpers.py imports the probe functions by name, so the eight names main() dispatches to still resolve in its own namespace - which is why the CLI tests' patch targets did not have to move.
The three probe-level test modules now import _transcribe_probes, the module whose namespace resolves those functions after the split. No re-export barrel was added.
transcribe.sh is untouched: it invokes tools/transcribe_helpers.py by path, and that path still exists with the same name and executable bit.
_transcribe_probes.py was given the executable bit to match the repo convention for a file carrying a shebang.
